description: Na₂Cr₂O₇ crystallizes in the triclinic P̅1 space group. There are four inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.32-2.62 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded to six O atoms to form NaO₆ octahedra that share  a cornercorner with one NaO₆ octahedra, corners with six CrO₄ tetrahedra,  an edgeedge with one NaO₆ octahedra, and  an edgeedge with one NaO₇ pentagonal bipyramid. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 72°. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.31-2.47 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded to six O atoms to form NaO₆ octahedra that share  a cornercorner with one NaO₆ octahedra, corners with six CrO₄ tetrahedra,  an edgeedge with one NaO₆ octahedra, and  an edgeedge with one NaO₇ pentagonal bipyramid. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 72°. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.34-2.44 Å. In the fourth Na site, Na is bonded to seven O atoms to form distorted NaO₇ pentagonal bipyramids that share corners with seven CrO₄ tetrahedra and edges with two NaO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.31-2.64 Å. There are four inequivalent Cr sites. In the first Cr site, Cr is bonded to four O atoms to form CrO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four NaO₆ octahedra, corners with two equivalent NaO₇ pentagonal bipyramids, and  a cornercorner with one CrO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 41-64°. There are a spread of Cr-O bond distances ranging from 1.61-1.77 Å. In the second Cr site, Cr is bonded to four O atoms to form CrO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with three NaO₆ octahedra,  a cornercorner with one NaO₇ pentagonal bipyramid, and  a cornercorner with one CrO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 48-59°. There are a spread of Cr-O bond distances ranging from 1.61-1.77 Å. In the third Cr site, Cr is bonded to four O atoms to form CrO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two NaO₆ octahedra, corners with two equivalent NaO₇ pentagonal bipyramids, and  a cornercorner with one CrO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 42-66°. There are a spread of Cr-O bond distances ranging from 1.61-1.76 Å. In the fourth Cr site, Cr is bonded to four O atoms to form CrO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with three NaO₆ octahedra, corners with two equivalent NaO₇ pentagonal bipyramids, and  a cornercorner with one CrO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 52-66°. There are three shorter (1.62 Å) and one longer (1.77 Å) Cr-O bond length. There are fourteen inequivalent O sites.
